concurrency_and_state: AlyraManager holds static HikariDataSource ds; reloadData() closes and recreates ds without synchronization against active callers.
PlayerDAO.extractSnapshot acquires synchronized(player) and synchronized(player.inventory.itemsBoxCrackBall), then releases lock before JDBC executeUpdate().

PlayerDAO.updatePlayerAsync and updatePlayersInTransactionAsync spawn unbounded virtual threads with no per-player save serialization; concurrent saves can write an older snapshot over a newer one, and player.lastSaveHash is read/written unsynchronized.
PlayerDAO.updateBlackBallReward performs non-transactional read-modify-write on data_black_ball without row lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE).
SuperRankDAO.loadData initializes new players using getCurrentHighestRank() + 1 without DB lock or unique constraint handling, risking duplicate rank assignment under concurrent logins.
DatabaseTemplateLoader.gI() is synchronized singleton; reloadAchievementTemplate() mutates Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE in place (clear + addAll) without synchronization.
EventDAO stores global event timers in static longs (remainingTimeToIncreasePotentialAndPower, HP, MP, Dame) without volatile or synchronization.
cross_module_questions: Which callers invoke AlyraManager.login vs NDVSqlFetcher.login? AlyraManager.login passes a id-only ResultSet to NDVSqlFetcher.loadPlayer and skips ban/maintenance checks.
Where is TraningDAO.updatePlayer called? Any updates it writes to data_luyentap are overwritten at login by data_training in NDVSqlFetcher.loadPlayer.
Are PlayerDAO.subvnd, subVND2, and subcash guarded by caller locks and balance checks, or can concurrent requests drive account.sotien / cash negative?
How is player.BoughtSkills used elsewhere in skill purchase/validation, given NDVSqlFetcher fails with ClassCastException on Long->int and PlayerDAO hardcodes "[]" on save?
What readers access Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE concurrently while DatabaseTemplateLoader.reloadAchievementTemplate() runs clear() + addAll()?

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Single HikariDataSource; sslMode defaults to DISABLED for localhost and VERIFY_IDENTITY for remote; executeQuery copies RS into ResultSetImpl and closes RS/PS/Con in finally/try, executeUpdate uses try-with-resources.

db_redis_touchpoints.op: SELECT account + SELECT id FROM player
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses PreparedStatement with ? params; however SELECT id FROM player is passed directly to loadPlayer() causing missing-column SQLException; misses ban/DEBUG checks.

db_redis_touchpoints.op: SELECT account, SELECT player, UPDATE account last_time_login/ip_address
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses parameterized queries; SELECT * FROM player; login() reads last_time_login/create_time Timestamps without null guards.
Uses AlyraManager.executeUpdate with values() auto-expansion; createNewPlayer writes "0" for data_achievement/giftcode instead of "[]".
Uses PreparedStatement; `rank` properly backticked; transaction sets autoCommit(false)/commit/rollback; hardcodes boughtSkills = "[]"; no per-player save ordering lock.

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: subvnd/subVND2/subcash lack `AND sotien >= ?` / `AND cash >= ?` guards and ignore affected row count; subvnd/subVND2 do not wrap PreparedStatement in try-with-resources.
Try-with-resources used, but non-transactional read-modify-write without FOR UPDATE lock.
Backticked columns, but PreparedStatement and ResultSet are not in try-with-resources and never explicitly closed.
Parameterized queries with try-with-resources; insert() silently catches and ignores exceptions.

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Try-with-resources used, but severe N+1 pattern querying tab_shop again per tab when loadShopTab already fetched the tab_shop row.
`rank` backticked; parameterized queries via AlyraManager; non-atomic highestRank+1 insert on new player; several silent catch blocks.
Parameterized query; writes 10-element data_luyentap while PlayerDAO writes 5-element data_luyentap + data_training, causing login desync.
Try-with-resources used for all queries; exits JVM on startup error; reloadAchievementTemplate mutates Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE unsafely.

findings.impact: Calling AlyraManager.login() crashes with SQLException on existing players (missing columns in rsPlayer) and allows banned/non-admin players to bypass ban and maintenance checks.
findings.root_cause: AlyraManager.login duplicates NDVSqlFetcher.login, passes `SELECT id FROM player` ResultSet directly into NDVSqlFetcher.loadPlayer() which expects all player columns, omits `ban` and `Manager.DEBUG` checks, omits `last_time_login` update, and omits `isAdmin` wait-time bypass.
findings.title: Broken duplicate login() in AlyraManager passes id-only ResultSet to loadPlayer() and skips ban/maintenance checks

findings.impact: Purchased skills (BoughtSkills) are lost on next login and overwritten with empty array in DB on every player save.
findings.root_cause: NDVSqlFetcher casts JSON-simple Long elements to primitive `(int) code`, throwing ClassCastException (silently swallowed), while PlayerDAO.extractSnapshot hardcodes `"[]"` for the `boughtSkills` parameter in QUERY_UPDATE_PLAYER.
findings.title: BoughtSkills permanently wiped on save and fails to load due to Long-to-int ClassCastException

findings.impact: Concurrent or unchecked deduction calls can drive account.sotien or account.cash negative or cause double-spend races.
findings.root_cause: subvnd, subVND2, and subcash execute `SET sotien = (sotien - ?)` / `SET cash = (cash - ?)` without `AND sotien >= ?` / `AND cash >= ?` WHERE guards, ignore affected row counts, and mutate session fields without synchronization.
findings.title: Unchecked currency deduction without SQL balance guard or row-count verification in PlayerDAO

findings.impact: Under concurrent auto-save, trade save, and logout save, an older snapshot can overwrite newer DB state (potential item/gold rollback or dupe window), and dirty-check hash visibility is not guaranteed across threads.
findings.root_cause: updatePlayerAsync/updatePlayersInTransactionAsync launch virtual threads with no per-player DB write lock after extractSnapshot releases synchronized(player), and player.lastSaveHash is read/written outside synchronization.
findings.title: Out-of-order async player DB writes possible due to missing per-player save serialization

findings.impact: talkToThanMeo state is lost/corrupted on relog (overwritten with talkToThuongDe), and Whis training/luyentap updates saved via TraningDAO are discarded on next login.
findings.root_cause: NDVSqlFetcher reads index 2 twice for both talkToThuongDe and talkToThanMeo instead of index 3; TraningDAO writes 10 elements to data_luyentap without updating data_training, which NDVSqlFetcher reads second and uses to overwrite player.traning.
findings.title: CDRD index copy-paste bug and TraningDAO vs data_training persistence mismatch on loadPlayer

findings.impact: New players fail to initialize achievement entries (swallowed ClassCastException) and players created via createPlAo or with null JSON columns fail to load at login.
findings.root_cause: createNewPlayer inserts integer 0 for data_achievement and giftcode which JSONValue.parse parses as Long (causing ClassCastException when cast to JSONArray), and loadPlayer parses several columns with raw `(JSONArray) JSONValue.parse(...)` without null checks.
findings.title: Unchecked JSONArray casts in NDVSqlFetcher.loadPlayer and invalid scalar '0' defaults in PlayerDAO.createNewPlayer

findings.impact: Violates JDBC try-with-resources invariant; leaves PreparedStatement/ResultSet open until Connection returns/closes or garbage collection, risking statement/cursor leaks under load.
findings.root_cause: EventDAO and PlayerDAO.subvnd/subVND2 open PreparedStatement (and ResultSet in EventDAO) outside try-with-resources; EventDAO and subVND2 never close ps/rs explicitly.
findings.title: PreparedStatement and ResultSet not managed with try-with-resources in EventDAO and PlayerDAO.subvnd/subVND2

findings.impact: Causes N+1 redundant queries on server startup/reload and wastes DB roundtrips on tab_shop.
findings.root_cause: loadShopTab runs `SELECT * FROM tab_shop WHERE shop_id = ?`, then for every tab calls loadItemShop which executes `SELECT * FROM tab_shop WHERE tab_index = ? AND shop_id = ?` on the exact same table/row instead of reading the `items` column directly.
findings.title: Redundant N+1 queries re-fetching tab_shop for every tab in ShopDAO

findings.impact: Concurrent SuperRank first-time initializations can assign duplicate ranks; concurrent BlackBall rewards can drop a star update; high stats (>2.14B) truncate in SuperRank display.
findings.root_cause: SuperRankDAO.loadData computes getCurrentHighestRank() + 1 outside a lock/transaction, and readData casts Long hp/dame/def to intValue(). PlayerDAO.updateBlackBallReward does SELECT then UPDATE without FOR UPDATE.
findings.title: Non-atomic read-modify-write in SuperRankDAO/updateBlackBallReward and int truncation in SuperRankDAO.readData

findings.impact: Concurrent readers of Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE during admin reload can hit ConcurrentModificationException or see an empty list mid-reload.
findings.root_cause: reloadAchievementTemplate() calls Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE.clear() and addAll(list) without synchronization or atomic reference swap.
findings.title: Unsynchronized in-place clear/addAll on Manager.ACHIEVEMENT_TEMPLATE during reload

findings.impact: Transaction audit errors and JSON parse errors are silently dropped; goldP1/goldP2 use int instead of long and gold1Before/After/gold2Before/After are never persisted.
findings.root_cause: Empty catch blocks swallow exceptions in HistoryTransactionDAO.insert, SuperRankDAO, and NDVSqlFetcher; HistoryTransactionDAO.insert uses += string concat in loops and ignores gold before/after args.
findings.title: Swallowed SQL/JSON exceptions and unused/int-typed gold parameters in HistoryTransactionDAO and SuperRankDAO

key_classes.name: AlyraManager
key_classes.responsibility: Manages HikariCP MySQL connection pool, executes parameterized SQL queries/updates, and contains a duplicate/broken login() method.

key_classes.name: AlyraResultSet
key_classes.responsibility: ResultSet abstraction interface decoupling callers from JDBC ResultSet lifecycle.

key_classes.name: EventDAO
key_classes.responsibility: Loads and persists global event countdown timers from/to `event` table.

key_classes.name: HistoryTransactionDAO
key_classes.responsibility: Records, searches, and cleans up player trade history in `history_transaction`.

key_classes.name: NDVSqlFetcher
key_classes.responsibility: Primary account login validator and full player/pet/inventory/task/JSON hydration from MySQL.

key_classes.name: PlayerDAO
key_classes.responsibility: Creates new/bot players, serializes PlayerSaveSnapshot, persists player state (sync/async/transactional), and mutates account balances/VIP flags.

key_classes.name: ShopDAO
key_classes.responsibility: Loads NPC shops, tabs, and shop item definitions from `shop` and `tab_shop`.

key_classes.name: SuperRankDAO
key_classes.responsibility: Loads, initializes, queries, and updates Super Rank tournament standings and history in `super_rank`.

key_classes.name: TraningDAO
key_classes.responsibility: Persists `data_luyentap` JSON column for a player.

key_classes.name: DatabaseTemplateLoader
key_classes.responsibility: Loads all game templates, clans, consign items, giftcodes, radar cards, and leaderboards on startup and exports `data/update_data/part`.

module_summary: Persistence layer built on HikariCP (`AlyraManager`) with JSON-packed player columns (`NDVSqlFetcher`, `PlayerDAO`), startup template hydration (`DatabaseTemplateLoader`), and feature DAOs (`ShopDAO`, `SuperRankDAO`, `HistoryTransactionDAO`, `EventDAO`, `TraningDAO`). Contains several critical issues including a broken duplicate login method in `AlyraManager`, `BoughtSkills` load/save loss, unchecked currency deductions, async save ordering races, missing try-with-resources in `EventDAO`/`PlayerDAO`, and N+1 `tab_shop` queries in `ShopDAO`.
